Definition: Eder, the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Eder = "a flock"; n pr m; 1) a Merarite Levite in the time of David; n pr loc; 2) a town in the extreme south of Judah on the border of Edom; site unknown
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
